response.rationale: R4 is supported by the direct statement that salivary duct carcinoma was initially considered, plus the FNA findings of dirty necrosis and pseudopapillary atypical cells, which are characteristic of a high-grade salivary malignancy. R3 (mucoepidermoid carcinoma) shares the FNA support but lacks the explicit diagnostic consideration and typically shows mucinous cells, which are absent here. R1 and R2 are contradicted by the suspicious cytology and the explicit consideration of malignancy.

rejected.why: Contradicted by the explicit consideration of salivary duct carcinoma; cytology with pseudopapillary atypical cells and dirty necrosis is not typical of Warthin tumor.
Contradicted by the FNA showing atypical cells and the explicit consideration of malignancy; pleomorphic adenoma would not show such cytology.
